assets.title: Dashboard health and attention feed
assets.caption: Fleet health starts with the one thing that needs attention: Jellyfin restart-spamming, backed by memory pressure and recent log context instead of a raw wall of charts.

assets.title: Host metrics across Docker, k3s, and Proxmox
assets.caption: The sample workspace mixes Docker, k3s, Proxmox VE, and HTTP endpoints so users can see host pressure and runtime status in one shared fleet view.

assets.title: Container diagnosis with log evidence
assets.caption: When a container is unhealthy, insightd ranks the likely cause, shows confidence, and keeps the exact log pattern and metric/restart/topology evidence beside the next action.

assets.title: Alert routes and calm delivery
assets.caption: Alerts are deduped, routed to Slack and ntfy, and suppressed when they match a known maintenance window so launch readers see calm notification behavior.

assets.title: Endpoint monitoring alongside infrastructure
assets.caption: HTTP checks live beside infrastructure signals: p95 latency, TLS age, status, and alert-route delivery stay visible without leaving the homelab dashboard.
